info.title: HammerTime API
info.description: Generate Discord timestamps and manage the settings of the HammerTime bot. Every timestamp endpoint is the bot command of the same name. The same commands are available to AI assistants as tools of the MCP server at /mcp, with the same API keys.

tags.name: settings
tags.description: The bot settings of the account

tags.name: keys
tags.description: About the API key in use

BearerAuth.description: An API key created on the HammerTime website, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`

timezone.description: The timezone the input was interpreted in, null for commands that have none

header.description: The exact time as interpreted, null when the header is turned off

content.description: The reply the bot would send: the optional header and the syntax/preview rows

format.description: Discord timestamp style (d, D, t, T, f, F, s, S or R)

timestamp.description: Markdown to paste into Discord, e.g. <t:1650802953:R>

executionNumber.description: How many times the command has been run, across Discord and the API

note.description: The sentence the bot appends to its replies

Telemetry.description: Present only when usage telemetry is enabled in the settings of the account the key acts as

code.description: Machine-readable reason. For rejected command input this is the bot's locale key, e.g. commands.at.responses.hourRange

message.description: English explanation, the same text the Discord bot replies with

issues.description: For invalid_request: what is wrong with which field

years.description: How many years to add to the specified timestamp

months.description: How many months to add to the specified timestamp

days.description: How many days to add to the specified timestamp

hours.description: How many hours to add to the specified timestamp

minutes.description: How many minutes to add to the specified timestamp

seconds.description: How many seconds to add to the specified timestamp

format.description: Returns only the specified format in the response Choices: d (short date), f (date and time), t (short time), D (long date), F (weekday, date and time), s (short date and short time), S (short date and long time), R (relative), T (long time), all (all (default)).

header.description: Display the initial time (as interpreted by the bot) on top of the response

columns.description: Specify which columns to display in the returned response Choices: both (both syntax and preview), preview (preview only), syntax (syntax only).

ephemeral.description: When true the response will only be visible to you

timezone.description: Timezone used when a command does not specify one

header.description: Whether replies start with the exact time as interpreted

boldPreview.description: Whether previews are bold when listing all formats

format.description: Only return this format instead of all of them

formatMinimalReply.description: With a single format, reply with just the preview

telemetry.description: Whether anonymous command usage is recorded, and the run count shown in replies

defaultAtHour.description: Hour (0-23) used by the at command when none is given

defaultAt12Hour.description: Hour (1-12) used by the at12 and at commands when none is given

defaultAtMinute.description: Minute used by the at commands when none is given

defaultAtSecond.description: Second used by the at commands when none is given

discordUserId.description: The Discord account the key acts as

post.description: Add some time to the specified UNIX timestamp. Equivalent to the bot's /add command: the same options, and any option left out falls back to the account's saved settings.

200.description: The timestamp, in every format or the requested one

400.description: The input is invalid, see error.code

401.description: The API key is missing, unknown, revoked or expired

403.description: The API key does not have the scope this endpoint needs

503.description: The service is read-only while it is being deployed, retry after the number of seconds in Retry-After
